prize.text: $10 per weekly one-round tournament, paid as Bonus Cash that cannot be withdrawn
prize.quote: Prizes are paid as Bonus Cash* ... *Bonus Cash can be used to enter tournaments, matches, and pay other fees on GamerSaloon. It is not eligible for withdrawal.

freeEntry.text: Free entry, one entry per person, Saturdays 4:30 PM CT
freeEntry.quote: These special free tournaments are limited to one entry per person, so pick your title wisely.

deadline.text: Weekly, Saturdays 4:30 PM CT, join before 4:30 PM CT
deadline.quote: Launched Weekly on Saturdays at 4:30 PM CT.

eligibility.text: 18+; console titles on PS4/PS5, Xbox One/Series

aiPolicy.quote: Not addressed on the promotion page.

payout.text: No cash withdrawal: prize is site credit only
payout.quote: It is not eligible for withdrawal.

summary: Free to enter, but the $10 is site credit, not money you can take out. The upstream ledger summarised this as '$10 cash per bracket', which the operator's own footnote contradicts.
flags: Upstream claim '$10 cash per bracket' is contradicted by the operator's own footnote: Bonus Cash is not withdrawable.
